correctness.rationale: Two independent complete finite enumerations (recursive matchings with explicit 24 squares; bipartite permutation enumeration with crossed-partner square switches) reproduce 272 states, 768 links and the entire 264-state distance matrix. BFS exhausts all legal neighbors, verifying eccentricities 252*7+12*8, radius 7, diameter 8, distance histogram and the 3C4 antipodal relation. The explicit distance-eight witness and all 384 natural cube symmetries are checked from the embedded source.

originality.rationale: The claimed new content is solely the exact shortest-path metric on the previously identified 264-state square-flip component, its 7/8 eccentricity classification, and symmetry of all twelve farthest pairs. In the fully inspected relevant sections, the closest paper proves the 272/9/264+8 counts but does not present these metric and orbit conclusions. Separate broad four-cycle reconfiguration results and an earlier broader-move result do not imply the metric after forbidding longer flips. value.rationale: The box is the canonical smallest nontrivial four-dimensional domino tiling case already known to have eight frozen states; finding its SHARP square-only shortest-move geometry is a motivated missing invariant not implied by prior component counts. The 12 peripheral states and their 3C4 farthest-pair graph give structural rather than just numerical information. The result supplies a complete benchmark for constrained perfect-matching reconfiguration and no mixing-time or general-dimension claims.
